name: helm-scope-none-on-error

escalations.question: The backlog row (F-U2, .sir/backlog.md:40) asks to hide COPY.scopeNone in the listing's error phase. HelmScopePicker.tsx:101 shows it whenever scopes.length === 0, which is also true while the listing is loading (HelmPanel.test.tsx:420 renders phase 'loading' with value []). Show it only when the listing phase is 'ready', or hide it only in 'error'?
escalations.answer: Show COPY.scopeNone only when the listing phase is 'ready' (the recommended option, chosen at Gate 1 through the choice dialog).

criteria: C1: HelmScopePicker renders COPY.scopeNone only when the scope listing's phase is 'ready' and the scope list is empty; HelmPanel.tsx passes the listing's phase (view.phase) to the picker. In 'idle', 'loading' and 'error' the sentence is not rendered.

C2: A new HelmPanel.test.tsx test renders phase 'error' with value [] and asserts the listing-failure text is on screen and COPY.scopeNone is not (queryByText returns null). It is shown failing against the unchanged HelmScopePicker.tsx before the fix (red step).
C3: A new HelmPanel.test.tsx test renders phase 'loading' with value [] and asserts COPY.scopeNone is not on screen.

C4: The existing test 'says so when there is nothing to edit at all' (HelmPanel.test.tsx:443-446 at ac6f0f6) still passes unedited, and COPY.scopeNone's text in src/renderer/src/helm/copy.ts is unchanged.
C5: `npm test` (whole suite, run from the repository root) and `npm run typecheck` both pass after the change, each also run before the change, and both runs' summary lines are reported.
C6: `git diff --name-only` lists only src/renderer/src/helm/HelmScopePicker.tsx, src/renderer/src/helm/HelmPanel.tsx and src/renderer/src/helm/HelmPanel.test.tsx.
C7: Gate 3 removes the F-U2 row (20261117-2333-handrun-unexercised-steps, 'when the `helm:scopes` listing fails') from .sir/backlog.md, and no open row cites a line this diff moved.
